label: Loop
subtitle: Loop a local audio file with count or infinite mode, plus optional pauses.

components.title: Audio Loop
components.subtitle: Choose, start, pause, resume, or stop loop playback with count or infinite mode.

props.nativeUnavailableCopy: This package is JSON-owned. The shared Expo runtime plays local audio on iOS, Android, and web; the macOS shell uses its native package player.

items.behavior: Pick a local audio file without uploading it.
Reset count and begin the loop.
Continue the loop after a pause.
Finish current play and move to next.
Stop playback and keep the selected file ready.

components.title: Recent Sessions
components.subtitle: Saved loop sessions appear here when the runtime persists them.
